title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E01 — Trial by Fire
An assassin's bullet sparks a global conflict that evolves into one of the deadliest wars in history; a generation of soldiers emerges, including a group of men who will become the most infamous leaders of the 20th century; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E04 — Civil War Cannoneers; Night Vision; Clearing a Minefield
Aiming Civil War artillery pieces; how night-vision technology works; how to clear a minefield.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Never Surrender
World leaders are called to action as war inevitably breaks out again; the men who came of age during wartime must rely upon experiences to fight a new conflict, as they face the greatest challenge humanity has ever seen; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E02 — A Rising Threat
After the fighting stops, tensions continue to simmer just beneath the surface, and few realize that the seeds of the next great global conflict have already been sown; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E01 — The War Hammer
The bladesmiths have to choose wisely as they are asked to dumpster dive for the right steel to be turned into a hardened blade of their choosing; after five days at their home forges, the smiths return their war hammers in hand.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E06 — The Elizabethan Rapier
The bladesmiths have to use an age-old technique to make their signature weapons; two finalists head to their home forges to create one of history's most notorious weapons, the rapier.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E07 — The Roman Gladius
After a hard round of tests that literally breaks a blade in two, the finalists get the chance to make one of the most important weapons from history, the Roman Gladius.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E08 — The Moro Kris
The bladesmiths have forged a signature weapon using everyday steel objects; two competitors will move on and are given only five days to create the mystical Moro Kris Sword, a distinctive blade that dates all the way back to 300 B.C.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E35 — Judges Takeover: J Neilson
Four smiths must create blades from the mind of J. Neilson; the remaining two must recreate the Maguindanao Kris.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E03 — Duel Swords
Three champions face off against each other, testing their signature blades and re-creating a weapon from the "Forged in Fire" vault until only one champion remains to face off against Ben Abbott, David Baker or J Neilson.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E08 — The Razor's Edge
Contestants compete with throwing knives and slingshots; in addition to the elimination challenge, another contestant suddenly goes home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E09 — The Shortest Fuse
The teams dissolve, as everyone competes for him or herself, and three people are ultimately sent home; In the first of two surprise challenges, everyone has to shoot a lit fuse sending the shortest fuse home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E03 — Uphill Battle
The teams try to blow up an ammo dump, using the legendary M1A rifle; one contestant's mistakes put his team in jeopardy; marksmen face obscured targets challenge using the Glock 17 pistol.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E04 — Compound Fracture
The contestants' archery skills are put to the test with a modern compound bow; tubular team challenge; tensions with team leadership threaten to unravel the group.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E10 — Season Finale
The final four contestants compete to determine the winner of the $100,000 prize.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E01 — Sharpshooter Surprise
16 competitors arrive from around the country and face a surprise right from Civil War history for an opportunity to choose teams; a team challenge of extreme billiards; an elimination challenge which sends the first two marksmen home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E02 — Shoot or Be Shot
Using prohibition era weapons, teams try to hit their targets, while being shot at with paintballs; two contestants face off with the iconic Tommy Gun.

title: American Pickers
description:
S11 E03 — The King's Ransom
The guys find an elephant, an alligator and a life-size sculpture of Elvis in rural Vermont; a treasure trove of folk art finds and rare military memorabilia; Danielle gets encouraging news from an appraiser.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E15 — Catch-32
Mike and Frank have their work cut out for them on a huge property with more custom 1932 Fords than they have ever seen in one place; Danielle takes on an important military mission.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E24 — Cold War Cruisin'
A 1962 Czechoslovakia scooter zooms into the shop; a mini 1930s oil tanker trucks into the shop.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E03 — Duck and Cover
The team restores a 1957 civil defense air raid siren; a nickel-plated cash register.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S17 E15 — Pawnsplosion
Rick has the chance to drive a WWII tank; vintage toy soldiers march into the shop; Rick and Corey are visited by Haunted Mansion memorabilia; Chum finds a flamethrower.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E33 — Moon Walking
Someone brings in a flag from one of NASA's final missions to the moon; Rick is presented with an 1861 Civil War Colt musket; Corey and Chumlee meet a guy selling his collection of NFL pins from the first 20 Super Bowls.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S02 E25 — Gold Diggers
A gold bar may be from a 1500s shipwreck; a celestial navigation dome from a B29 bomber; mint condition collection of American League baseball field passes.

title: Pawn Stars
description:

An engraved whale's tooth may be authentic 19th-century scrimshaw; Civil War-era rifles; a pristine copy of Playboy's first issue.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S17 E25 — Pawnfellas
A World War II mortar; handcuffs from an iconic prison; a tuxedo worn by actor Ray Liotta; a bar of soap that supposedly cures obesity.

description:
